jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.

About The Job You're Considering

We are looking for a data analyst to support the migration of the applications by analyzing the existing systems, data flows, and downstream dependencies.

Your role

Strong in Delivery Management expertise for creating Project Plan, Road maps, risk and mitigation plans etc..
Role involves deep-dive data analysis, mapping legacy structures to modern cloud-based solutions, and ensuring data accuracy throughout the migration lifecycle.
Analyst will work closely with engineering, product, and business teams to translate requirements, validate data, and support testing.

Skills And Experience

Strong in Delivery Management expertise.
Strong understanding in SQL, Snowflake, Azure and AWS and cloud platforms is essential.
Excellent communication skills to collaborate effectively with technical teams and executive stakeholders.

The base compensation range for this role in the posted location is: $112,700 - $148,000.

jobs.title: Hydrogeologist/Hydrologist
jobs.description:
Foth
is a 100% member-owned science and engineering consulting firm headquartered in Wisconsin, with over 85 years of success. Our 750 members across 33 locations are dedicated to solving our clients’ toughest science and engineering challenges
. Consistently ranked by Engineering News Record in the top 150 firms, we offer a values-based, collaborative, and flexible work environment with professional growth opportunities. If you thrive working alongside a smart and caring team, Foth
may be the place for you.

Join our team and experience the Foth
difference that contributes to our impressive 92+% member retention rate
! Learn more at foth.com/careers.

Foth
is seeking a team-focused, innovative, and results-oriented Hydrogeologist / Hydrologist
, who has a desire to contribute to our clients' success and is looking for new learning experiences and opportunities for career growth. This position will be working out of our Green Bay, WI, Madison, WI, Minneapolis, MN
, or Duluth, MN
office locations.

Primary Responsibilities

Support hydrogeology and surface water hydrology projects in the environmental services industry
Conduct field investigations, including aquifer testing, surface water discharge gauging, and geologic logging/mapping
Develop and apply numerical groundwater flow and transport models in support of project permitting, industrial development, and site remediation
Execute technical investigations for hydrologic characterization of groundwater systems in environments comprised of unconsolidated deposits, sedimentary rock, and fractured crystalline rock
Perform quantitative analysis of hydrologic and hydrogeological data, including probabilistic analysis and forecasting
Develop technical investigation plans for hydrologic characterization of groundwater systems in environments comprised of unconsolidated deposits, sedimentary rock, and fractured crystalline rock
Develop technical reports and memos to support the permitting of natural resource development project
Be part of a multidisciplinary team of engineers and scientists
Provide construction support and administration

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Environmental Engineering, or related engineering
Professional experience performing hydrogeological and hydrologic investigations, analysis, and modeling, through internships or co-ops
Technical writing and report preparation experience
Proficiency with groundwater and surface water modeling tools, such as MODFLOW/MT3D, FEFLOW, HEC-RAS, HEC-HMS, XP-SWMM, or similar numerical codes

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s degree in Water Resources Engineering, Geology, or a related field, with 2+ years of experience in water resources or hydrogeology, preferably supporting mining applications
Experience developing and applying numerical groundwater flow, constituent transport, and surface water hydrology/hydraulic models, including work in unconsolidated, sedimentary, fractured rock, and deep bedrock environments
Experience planning, coordinating, and executing hydrogeologic and hydrologic field investigations, including packer testing, multi-well aquifer testing, and analysis of field and large data sets
Demonstrated ability to perform data analysis, statistical/probabilistic modeling, and time-series forecasting for hydrologic and hydrogeologic systems
Experience integrating hydrogeologic and hydrologic analyses with feasibility studies, alternatives analyses, and mine permitting efforts
Familiarity with NEPA processes and documentation and mine permitting in the United States

jobs.title: Project Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
Join Excel Fluid Group

Project Solutions Engineer

This is a fulltime first shift position (Monday – Friday) 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM

Position Overview

The Project Solutions Engineer serves as an in-house engineering resource for the Business Development and Project Sales teams, with a focus on reviewing opportunities early, strengthening technical recommendations, and helping move qualified projects from initial review to a clearly scoped, specifiable solution. This role is intended to provide practical engineering judgment, support customer-facing technical credibility, and help give the buyer or specifying engineer confidence in EFG’s design recommendations.

The position supports the BD team by reviewing project information as opportunities come in, commenting on design considerations, identifying risks or gaps, and helping determine whether EFG’s recommended solution is technically appropriate. The role should keep the BD team involved in the customer relationship while reducing the time spent on detailed technical review, design interpretation, and engineering coordination.

For candidates with Professional Engineer licensure, this role may include responsible review and stamping of applicable project work once the individual has developed sufficient familiarity with EFG’s process, standards, products, and internal controls. Use of a professional stamp must be based on sound engineering judgment, proper review, and comfort with the scope of responsibility.

Responsibilities

Duties would include but not limited to:

Review specifications, drawings, and project data early in the opportunity process to evaluate feasibility, application fit, and technical risk.
Provide practical design comments and engineering recommendations that support BD discussions with buyers, engineers, and project stakeholders.
Help translate customer needs, site conditions, and project requirements into technically sound, cost-conscious system solutions.
Assess hydraulic, civil, electrical, structural, and site-specific considerations to identify concerns before proposals or recommendations are finalized.
Prepare early-stage documentation, including technical summaries, design assumptions, equipment recommendations, review notes, and preliminary layouts.
Prepare design reports, engineering review packages, and supporting documentation for review by external engineers or other qualified reviewers.
Participate in client calls, site visits, pre-bid discussions, and engineer-facing conversations when technical credibility or clarification is needed.
Collaborate with Business Development, Project Sales, internal engineering resources, and external subject matter experts to refine defensible system designs, proposal strategy, and project handoff.
Support responsible engineering review of applicable project work, including stamped work where appropriate based on licensure, review standards, and scope of responsibility.
Maintain current knowledge of EFG products, component manufacturers, industry standards, and application best practices.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or related engineering discipline required.
Active Professional Engineer license required or strongly preferred; Civil PE or PE with directly relevant water/wastewater, municipal infrastructure, pump station, or site development experience preferred.
5+ years of relevant experience in civil, water/wastewater, pump station, utility, or infrastructure-related engineering preferred.
Demonstrated ability to review plans, specifications, submittals, and project requirements and provide practical engineering recommendations.
Comfortable working directly with Business Development and Sales teams in a fast-moving opportunity environment.
Ability and willingness, where properly licensed and supported by adequate review, to take professional responsibility for applicable engineering work.
Solid understanding of pumps, hydraulics, site layout considerations, and project design coordination.
Excellent technical writing, communication, and judgment skills.

Must Have Personal Transportation

Applied Archaeology and History Associates, Inc. (AAHA), a small, woman-owned cultural resources consulting firm located in Crofton, Maryland, has immediate openings for local archaeological field technicians for current and upcoming projects in Virginia and Maryland.

Nine Engineering specializes in drafting and design services for the gas distribution
and telecommunications
industries. We support utility companies, contractors, and municipalities with precise, compliant, and efficient engineering designs. Our team values accuracy, collaboration, and innovation in every project we deliver.

Position Overview

We’re looking for a Project Coordinator / Quality Control Specialist
